name: FrameViewer
tagline: 在照片视频播放页显示胶片式画面预览，拖动即可快速定位。
description: FrameViewer（帧检视器）会在系统“照片”的普通视频播放页面底部显示连续缩略图，方便直接拖动并定位视频画面。
无需进入编辑模式，也不会修改原始视频；新版照片界面和原生进度条会继续保留。
notice: ⚠️ 最低需要 iOS 18.0。Rootless 已在 iPhone 11 Pro / iOS 18.5 上确认可用；RootHide 与其他系统版本仍需测试。
features: 胶片式视频缩略图预览
支持左右拖动快速定位视频画面
无需进入编辑模式且不会修改原始视频
保留新版照片界面与原生进度条
默认关闭，可随时在设置中启用或停用
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后重新打开“设置”和“照片”。
前往“设置”中的帧检视器并开启“启用帧检视器”。
在照片中正常播放视频，通过底部胶片预览左右拖动定位。

changes: 首次发布：在普通视频播放页面显示胶片预览并支持拖动定位。
新增默认关闭的设置开关、设置图标与三语言界面。
提供 Rootless 与 RootHide 软件包，最低支持 iOS 18.0。

en.name: FrameViewer
en.tagline: A filmstrip of video previews in Photos with drag-to-seek controls.
description: FrameViewer adds a continuous thumbnail filmstrip to the bottom of the normal Photos video playback screen, letting you drag directly to the moment you want.
It works without entering Edit or changing the original video, while preserving the redesigned Photos interface and native progress bar.
en.notice: ⚠️ Requires iOS 18.0 or later. Rootless is user-confirmed on an iPhone 11 Pro running iOS 18.5; RootHide and other system versions still require testing.
features: Drag horizontally to seek quickly through a video
No need to enter Edit and no changes to the original video
Preserves the redesigned Photos interface and native progress bar
Disabled by default with an enable or disable switch in Settings
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Reopen Settings and Photos after installation.
Open FrameViewer in Settings and enable Enable FrameViewer.
Play a video normally in Photos and drag through the bottom filmstrip to seek.

changes: Initial release with filmstrip previews and drag-to-seek controls during normal video playback.
Added a disabled-by-default Settings switch, Settings icon, and three-language interface.
Added Rootless and RootHide packages with iOS 18.0 as the minimum version.
